lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke runs through the winding tunnel.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: This is insane. This is completely insane.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Am I dreaming? Did I hit my head when I fell off the truck?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The tunnel seems to go on forever.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke emerges from the tunnel and finds himself in a parking lot.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: A parking lot! A normal parking lot!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: I made it! I actually made it!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait... I still don't have Professor Layton. And I don't even know what I'm supposed to buy.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But at least I'm back in... well, something resembling reality.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Okay, there are actual employees here. That's a good sign.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait! That phone! It's the same kind Professor bought!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: If I can get that, maybe I can figure out where he is!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But as Luke reaches for it, someone else grabs it first.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Tube... Dude? Where did you come from?!
